newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate EPS view cut.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it cut its fourth quarter earnings estimates on Seagate Technology Inc to $0.65 a share from $0.96 a share.
-- said cut the 1997 earnings estimates to $3.02 a share from $3.33 a share.

-- On Tuesday, Seagate issued its second earnings forecast in two weeks, telling investors revenues for the quarter ended June 27 were now expected to be between $2.0 billion and $2.1 billion. The company also warned that weak demand for high-end products and some internal production issues would result in a "significant impact" on earnings.
